summary: Before the hull meets the march, Eren speaks in the paths as if the dawn were already chosen. Armin hears a friend. The sky outside then shows the same choice as light.

segments.ja: 船体の外が白む前に、道がもう一度開きます。開く場所に、エレンが立っています。立っている相手は、アルミンです。アルミンは、夜に残した会話が届いたのかと聞きます。聞く答えは、届いたのではなく、最初から見えていた、です。見えていた未来を、エレンは夜明けのように話します。話す光は、まだ外の空ではありません。ではありません。道の中の、先に歩いた時刻です。先に歩いた時刻は、友の質問より早いです。
segments.en: Before the outside of the hull whitens, the paths open again. Eren is standing in the place that opens. The person he is standing toward is Armin. Armin asks whether the conversation left in the night has arrived. The answer he hears is that it did not arrive. It was seen from the start. Eren talks about the future that was seen as if it were a dawn. The light he talks about is not yet the sky outside. It is not. It is a hour already walked, inside the paths. The hour already walked is earlier than the friend's question.

segments.titleJa: エレンは選んだと言う
segments.ja: エレンは、行進を誰かに命じられた結果だとは言いません。言わない理由は、自分がユミルに選択を渡し、その選択で壁が歩いた、です。歩いた未来を、彼はアルミンに隠そうとしません。隠さない顔は、港でミカサが拒んだ語に近いです。近いことを、彼は友の痛みとして認めます。認める内容は、止める側に回るなら、君たちだ、です。だ、を、アルミンはすぐに受けません。すぐに受けない友が、道の中で一番長い時間を使います。
segments.en: Eren does not say the march is the result of being ordered by someone. The reason he does not say it is that he handed Ymir a choice, and by that choice the walls walked. He does not try to hide the future that walked from Armin. The face that does not hide is close to the word Mikasa refused at the port. He admits the closeness as a friend's pain. The content he admits is that if someone turns to the side that stops him, it is them. Armin does not receive that at once. The friend who does not receive it at once spends the longest time inside the paths.

segments.ja: アルミンは、道の中で海の約束を置きます。置く約束は、外の世界を見ることでした。見た世界が、今は踏まれる側です。側を、彼はエレンの自由の言葉と並べます。並べた二つの言葉は、もう同じ方向を向いていません。向いていないことを、エレンは否定しません。否定しない沈黙が、友の会話としては一番重いです。重い会話を、アルミンはそれでも最後まで聞きます。最後まで聞いた会話は、停止のボタンではありません。
segments.en: Inside the paths, Armin sets down the promise of the sea. The promise he sets down was to see the outside world. The world they saw is now the side being trampled. He lines that side up with Eren's word freedom. The two words he lined up no longer face the same direction. Eren does not deny that they do not face it. The silence of not denying is the heaviest thing as a friend's conversation. Even so, Armin hears the heavy conversation to the end. The conversation heard to the end is not a button that stops it.

segments.ja: 同じ道の別の席に、ミカサがいます。いる席で、彼女はエレンの短い時間を見ます。見る時間は、マフラーがまだただの布だった頃に戻ります。戻る光景を、今日の話は長い台詞にはしません。しません。置くのは、彼がミカサの選択を、行進の外に残した、です。残した選択を、彼女は道の中ではまだ知り切りません。知り切らないまま、目が覚めれば船体の窓に戻ります。
segments.en: In another seat of the same paths, Mikasa is there. In the seat she is in, she sees a short time of Eren. The time she sees returns to when the scarf was still only cloth. Today's story does not turn the scene that returns into a long speech. It does not. What it sets down is that he left Mikasa's choice outside the march. She does not yet fully know the choice he left, inside the paths. Without fully knowing, when she wakes she returns to the hull's window.

segments.titleJa: ユミルはまだ見ている
segments.ja: ユミルは、この会話の奥で見ています。見ている二千年は、選択を受け取ったあとでも完全には解けていません。解けていない鎖を、ジークはもう自分の鍵とは呼べません。呼べない位置で、彼は弟の夜明けを横から見ます。見る夜明けは、芝生の静かな終わりではありません。ではありません。踏む光です。光を、兄は止められません。止められないことが、道の中の彼の最後の理解に近いです。近い理解は、兄の勝利ではありません。
segments.en: Ymir is watching in the depth of this conversation. The two thousand years she is watching have not fully come undone even after she received the choice. Zeke can no longer call the chain that has not come undone his own key. From the position where he cannot call it that, he looks from the side at his younger brother's dawn. The dawn he looks at is not the quiet end of the grass. It is not. It is a light that tramples. The older brother cannot stop the light. The cannot stop is close to his last understanding inside the paths. The close understanding is not the older brother's victory.

segments.titleJa: ジークは芝生を閉じる
segments.ja: ジークは、クサヴァーのボールをこの道では出しません。出さない理由は、もう聞き手がいない、です。いない計画を、彼は弟の光の横に置いたまま黙ります。黙る顔は、父を止めたかった顔の続きです。続きは、ここでは勝ちません。勝たない兄が、ユミルの視線の端に残ります。残ることを、エレンは邪魔だとは言いません。言わないまま、友との会話を終えます。
segments.en: In these paths, Zeke does not bring out Ksaver's ball. The reason he does not bring it out is that there is no longer a listener. He stays silent with the plan that has no listener, set beside his younger brother's light. The silent face is a continuation of the face that wanted to stop his father. The continuation does not win here. The older brother who does not win remains at the edge of Ymir's gaze. Eren does not call the remaining a nuisance. Without saying it, he ends the conversation with his friend.

segments.ja: 道の外、島の王座にヒストリアがいます。いる女王は、この会話を聞いていません。聞いていないまま、壁が抜けたあとの民を数えています。数える民の空は、船体の窓より近いです。近い空でも、行進の音は届いています。届いている音を、彼女は政治の一文では消せません。消せない夜明けが、島の側にも同時に来ます。来る光は、救いの色ではありません。救いの色ではない光が、王座の空にも来ます。
segments.en: Outside the paths, Historia is on the island's throne. The queen who is there is not hearing this conversation. Without hearing it, she is counting the people after the walls opened. The sky of the people she counts is closer than the hull's window. Even in the close sky, the sound of the march has arrived. She cannot erase the sound that has arrived with one sentence of politics. A dawn that cannot be erased comes to the island's side at the same time. The light that comes is not the color of salvation. Light that is not the color of salvation comes to the sky of the throne too.

segments.titleJa: ハンジは外の空を見る
segments.titleEn: Hange looks at the outside sky
segments.ja: 道から戻ったあと、ハンジは船体の外の空を見ます。見る空は、話していた光とは別の白さです。別の白さが、海の列の上に乗っています。乗っている列を、彼女は初めて水平線そのものとして見ます。見る水平線は、夜に置いた数より大きいです。大きい事実を、リヴァイのいる側へ短く伝えます。伝える相手は、まだ完全には立てません。立てない耳が、それでも列の音を拾います。水平線の幅は、窓の枠を超えます。
segments.en: After returning from the paths, Hange looks at the sky outside the hull. The sky she looks at is a different whiteness from the light they were talking about. The different whiteness sits on the row of the sea. For the first time, she looks at the row that sits there as the horizon itself. The horizon she looks at is larger than the count set down in the night. She reports the large fact shortly to the side where Levi is. The person she reports to still cannot fully stand. The ear that cannot stand still picks up the sound of the row. The width of the horizon exceeds the window's frame.

segments.en: Levi remains with the sight that narrowed after the forest. The ear of that remaining picks up the low sound of the march. The mouth that knows returns a short word to Hange. The content he returns is: ask what it meant to bring us this far. The ask is less an order than the pride that remained.

segments.ja: オニャンコポンは、列の光が窓を満たしても高さを保ちます。保つ理由は、落ちれば会話さえ届かない、です。届かない高さを、彼はキヨミと短い数字で分けます。分ける数字は、手順の一覧ではありません。ではありません。あとどれだけこの光の上にいられるか、です。いられる時間を、ジャンが後ろで聞きます。聞く顔は、皿を置いた夜の顔の続きです。
segments.en: Even when the row's light fills the window, Onyankopon holds the height. The reason he holds it is that if they fall, not even a conversation can arrive. He shares the height that must arrive with Kiyomi in short numbers. The numbers they share are not a list of procedures. They are not. They are how long they can still stay above this light. Jean hears the time they can stay, from behind. The face that hears is a continuation of the face from the night he set down the plate.

segments.titleEn: Armin still holds the words when he wakes
segments.ja: アルミンは、道の会話を船体の床で思い出します。思い出す内容は、止める側が自分たちだ、です。だ、を、彼はミカサとジャンに全部は渡しません。渡さない理由は、道の中の言葉がまだ私のものだ、です。ものの中心は、エレンが自由を行進の形にした、です。にした形を、友は後悔と一緒に見せました。見せた後悔は、停止のボタンではありません。見せた後悔は、船体の床でも消えていません。
segments.en: On the hull's floor, Armin remembers the conversation of the paths. The content he remembers is that the side that stops him is themselves. He does not hand all of that to Mikasa and Jean. The reason he does not hand it is that the words inside the paths are still his. The center of what is his is that Eren made freedom into the shape of the march. The friend showed the shape he made together with regret. The regret he showed is not a button that stops it. The regret he showed has not vanished even on the hull's floor.

segments.en: The light of the paths and the sky outside finally overlap. The people of the hull look at the hour that overlaps as a dawn. The dawn they look at is not a color in which humanity is saved. It is not. It is a color in which the row has made the horizon into its own width. Under the color, the island, the port, and the plate are small. Hange does not deny the small things. With the mouth that does not deny them, she says the next action is no longer turning back. The words that they are no longer turning back remain in the white sky.

segments.titleEn: The dawn is not one color
segments.ja: この夜明けは、一つの色ではありません。ではありません。エレンが見せた先の時刻と、船体が見ている今の空が重なった色です。重なった色の中で、ユミルはまだ見ていて、ジークは黙り、アルミンは言葉を持っています。持っている言葉は、友を止めろという命令にはなっていません。なっていないまま、水平線は近づきます。近づく光を、誰も美しい朝とは呼びません。近づく水平線は、美しい朝の言葉を拒みます。
segments.en: This dawn is not one color. It is not. It is a color in which the hour ahead that Eren showed and the sky the hull is seeing now have overlapped. Inside the overlapped color, Ymir is still watching, Zeke is silent, and Armin holds the words. The words he holds have not become an order to stop a friend. Without having become one, the horizon approaches. Nobody calls the light that approaches a beautiful morning. The approaching horizon refuses the words of a beautiful morning.

The silence of not denying is the heaviest thing as a friend's conversation. Even so, Armin hears the heavy conversation to the end. The conversation heard to the end is not a button that stops it.

vocab.exampleJa: 見えていた未来を、エレンは夜明けのように話します。
vocab.exampleEn: Before the outside of the hull whitens, the paths open again. Eren is standing in the place that opens. The person he is standing toward is Armin. Armin asks whether the conversation left in the night has arrived. The answer he hears is that it did not arrive. It was seen from the start. Eren talks about the future that was seen as if it were a dawn. The light he talks about is not yet the sky outside. It is not. It is a hour already walked, inside the paths. The hour already walked is earlier than the friend's question.

vocab.exampleJa: 聞け、は命令というより、残った矜持です。
vocab.exampleEn: Levi remains with the sight that narrowed after the forest. The ear of that remaining picks up the low sound of the march. The sound he picks up resembles the worst of the time he doubted the bottles. The worst that resembles it is now the width of the sea. He knows he cannot fully chase that width. The mouth that knows returns a short word to Hange. The content he returns is: ask what it meant to bring us this far. The ask is less an order than the pride that remained.

vocab.exampleJa: 消せない夜明けが、島の側にも同時に来ます。
vocab.exampleEn: Outside the paths, Historia is on the island's throne. The queen who is there is not hearing this conversation. Without hearing it, she is counting the people after the walls opened. The sky of the people she counts is closer than the hull's window. Even in the close sky, the sound of the march has arrived. She cannot erase the sound that has arrived with one sentence of politics. A dawn that cannot be erased comes to the island's side at the same time. The light that comes is not the color of salvation. Light that is not the color of salvation comes to the sky of the throne too.

vocab.exampleJa: 止められないことが、道の中の彼の最後の理解に近いです。
vocab.exampleEn: Ymir is watching in the depth of this conversation. The two thousand years she is watching have not fully come undone even after she received the choice. Zeke can no longer call the chain that has not come undone his own key. From the position where he cannot call it that, he looks from the side at his younger brother's dawn. The dawn he looks at is not the quiet end of the grass. It is not. It is a light that tramples. The older brother cannot stop the light. The cannot stop is close to his last understanding inside the paths. The close understanding is not the older brother's victory.

vocab.exampleJa: 開く場所に、エレンが立っています。
vocab.exampleEn: Before the outside of the hull whitens, the paths open again. Eren is standing in the place that opens. The person he is standing toward is Armin. Armin asks whether the conversation left in the night has arrived. The answer he hears is that it did not arrive. It was seen from the start. Eren talks about the future that was seen as if it were a dawn. The light he talks about is not yet the sky outside. It is not. It is a hour already walked, inside the paths. The hour already walked is earlier than the friend's question.

vocab.exampleJa: 伝える相手は、まだ完全には立てません。
vocab.exampleEn: After returning from the paths, Hange looks at the sky outside the hull. The sky she looks at is a different whiteness from the light they were talking about. The different whiteness sits on the row of the sea. For the first time, she looks at the row that sits there as the horizon itself. The horizon she looks at is larger than the count set down in the night. She reports the large fact shortly to the side where Levi is. The person she reports to still cannot fully stand. The ear that cannot stand still picks up the sound of the row. The width of the horizon exceeds the window's frame.
